what_to_detect: A resolution record whose cost half records an optional additional cost paid (a sacrifice or other payment in costs, or the gen-3 state costs_paid) on a spell whose script conditions an effect on it.
near_miss: The same kind of spell resolved with the optional cost unpaid.

what_to_detect: A resolution of a spell whose optional-cost-conditional part has a target, with targets chosen only when the optional additional cost was paid (state.refs.targets non-empty together with costs_paid).
near_miss: The same spell resolved with the optional cost unpaid and no target for that part.
